title: Thinkers AI Tutor
subtitle: Your Personal Learning Assistant
welcome:
Hi, I’m Thinkers AI Tutor 👋
I can help you understand lessons, summarize content, create quizzes, and answer programming questions.
disclaimer: AI guidance can make mistakes. Verify important information.

quickActions.explainPrompt: Explain this lesson clearly and give me a useful example.
quickActions.summaryPrompt: Summarize this lesson into concise key points.
quickActions.quizPrompt: Create a short quiz to test my understanding of this lesson.
quickActions.coursePrompt: What should I know about this course and how should I study it?

tools.title: Your personal study toolkit.
tools.description: Understand faster, practice actively, and know exactly what to learn next with Thinkers AI Tutor.
tools.summaryEmpty: Generate a concise overview and three practical takeaways.

code.title: AI Code Assistant
code.explainPrompt: Explain this code clearly, including what each important part does.
code.fixPrompt: Find bugs in this code and provide a corrected version with a short explanation.
code.optimizePrompt: Review and optimize this code for clarity, correctness, and maintainability.

quizTool.title: AI Quiz Generator
quizTool.heading: Quiz me on {{topic}}
quizTool.review: Review the explanations and try again.

motivation.title: Thinkers AI motivation
motivation.footer: Stay curious and keep your momentum.

defaults.noContent: There is no lesson content available to summarize.

conversations.title: Conversations
conversations.clearConfirm: Clear this chat? Its saved messages will be deleted.

lessonActions.title: Learn this lesson with Thinkers AI
lessonActions.description: Explain difficult ideas, build a concise summary, test your understanding, or continue the conversation.

errors.server: Thinkers AI cannot reach the server. Check that Laravel is running and try again.
errors.auth: Please sign in to use Thinkers AI.
errors.expired: Your session expired. Refresh the page, sign in again, and retry.
